title: Cowboys with Horses, Fenced Ranch Pasture - Antique 1910s Sepia Snapshot Photo
description: An early 20th-century snapshot capturing figures standing with saddles and horses in an open, sunlit pasture or corral. The composition is uniquely framed from behind chicken-wire fencing and a thick vertical wooden post on the left. The figures wear wide-brimmed hats and work clothing characteristic of early American ranching culture.
